prospective_rule.scope: General immutable native type schema-key caching, selected only from accepted31 optimization profiles of mvt and bicg. No holdout profiling or case selection.

training_probe.select_if: Raw geometric-mean speedup > 1.0; retain all samples, cases and regressions; no retries or exclusions.

prospective_rule.formal_gate: Commit and freeze source and driver before BOTH full sets; five samples per actor/mode, original-baseline replay, strict improvement of BOTH geometric-mean Mech/C kernel scores over accepted31.
invariants: Recompute cached semantic key from immutable schema during every source/image type construction.
Keep cached key private and absent from wire formats; changed/untrusted image keys cannot assert identity.
No native entry ABI, invocation layout, work fee, resource admission or timing-boundary change.
Use actual checked original/decoded/image executions; preserve finite failures, current keys, scalar lowering and first changes.
required_qualification: Native type/image reconstruction and rejection tests, including same-ID different schemas.
Maintained numeric, matrix, PolyBench, program, protocol and ABI regressions.
Runtime-only and full compiler feature builds.

decision: Select unchanged qualified native type schema-key cache for frozen formal both-set evaluation.
